extracted.intended_audience: British parliamentarians, government commissioners, and administrators responsible for Indian governance (late 18th century)
extracted.subtask_description: Legislative and administrative standards and procedures for investigating corruption and for managing assigned revenues and territories in British India, including powers for commissioners and rules for contracting/assignment of native lands. The page collects clauses of bills and committee recommendations about oversight, auditing, and revenue administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigative method: combination and comparison of circumstances
rubrics_metrics.description: Clandestine and collusive practice can only be traced by combination and comparison of circumstances. To reject such combination and comparison is to reject the only means of detecting fraud; it is, indeed, to give it a patent and free license to cheat with impunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When alleging clandestine or collusive misconduct, investigators should assemble and compare multiple circumstances and pieces of evidence rather than rely on single isolated facts; refusal to use such combination undermines detection of fraud.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commissioners' authority to examine on oath (Mr Pitt's Bill)
rubrics_metrics.description: The commissioners ... are hereby empowered, authorized, and required, to examine upon oath (which oath they, or any two of them, are hereby authorized to administer) the several persons, of all descriptions, belonging to any of the offices or departments before mentioned, and all other persons whom the said commissioners, or any two of them, shall think fit to examine, touching the business of each office or department, and the fees, gratuities, perquisites, and emoluments taken therein, and touching all other matters and things necessary for the execution of the powers vested in the said commissioners by this act; all which persons are hereby required and directed punctually to attend the said commissioners, at such time and place as they, or any two of them, shall appoint, and also to observe and execute such orders and directions as the said commissioners, or any two of them, shall make or give for the purposes before mentioned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commissioners may compel testimony under oath from any persons connected to relevant offices or departments and may require attendance and obedience to their orders; this is a statutory power intended to enable thorough fact-finding about fees, gratuities, perquisites, emoluments, and related matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commissioners' power to obtain documents and enforce precepts
rubrics_metrics.description: The said commissioners, or any two of them, are hereby authorized to meet and sit, from time to time, in such place or places as they shall find most convenient, with, or without adjournment, and to send their precept or precepts, under their hands and seals, for any person or persons whatsoever, and for such books, papers, writings, or records, as they shall judge necessary for their information, relating to any of the offices or departments hereinbefore mentioned; and all bailiffs, constables, sheriffs, and other his Majesty's officers, are hereby required to obey and execute such orders and precepts aforesaid as shall be sent to them, or any of them, by the said commissioners, or any two of them, touching the premises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statutory authority to subpoena documents and compel their production, with executive officers (bailiffs, constables, sheriffs) obliged to execute commissioners' orders; designed to ensure access to records necessary to investigate abuses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on assignment or mortgage of native territories to British subjects (Fox's India Bill)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Nabob of Arcot, the Rajah of Tanjore, or any other native protected prince in India, shall not assign, mortgage, or pledge any territory or land whatsoever, or the produce or revenue thereof, to any British subject whatsoever; neither shall it be lawful to and for any British subject whatsoever to take or receive any such assignment, mortgage, or pledge; and the same are hereby declared to be null and void; and all payments or deliveries of produce or revenue, under any such assignment, shall and may be recovered back, by such native prince paying or delivering the same, from the person or persons receiving the same, or his or their representatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any transfer, mortgage, or pledge of native territory or its revenues to British subjects is voidable and recoverable; the clause is a legislative safeguard against private appropriation of native lands and revenues by British individuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assigned revenue administration: collect and digest accounts; diagnose causes of mismanagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Our aim in it is briefly to explain the state of the Carnatic at the period of the Nabob's assignment,--the particular causes which existed to the prejudice of that assignment, after it was made,--and the measures which your Lordship, &c., have, upon our recommendation, adopted for removing those causes, and introducing a more regular and beneficial system of management in the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrators should produce a concise summary report that (1) explains the pre-assignment condition, (2) identifies causes prejudicial to the assignment, and (3) recommends concrete measures to remove those causes and introduce regular, beneficial management; thorough accounting and diagnosis are required before reforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assigned revenue management: immediate reduction of expenses and replacement of corrupt agents
rubrics_metrics.description: We proposed a considerable and immediate reduction of expenses, and a total change of the principal aumildars who had been employed under the Nabob.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When assigned revenues reflect heavy expenses and mismanagement, the committee recommends aggressive retrenchment of expenditures and wholesale replacement of principal local revenue agents (aumildars) to restore fiscal viability; err on the side of trimming too much rather than too little, since increases are easier to restore than cuts to be later imposed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assigned revenue management: farm districts by public advertisement and guarantee protection to renters
rubrics_metrics.description: We judged it expedient to recommend that such of the Nabob's districts as were in a state to be farmed out might be immediately let by a public advertisement, issued in the Company's name, and circulated through every province of the Carnatic; and, with the view of encouraging bidders, we proposed that the countries might be advertised for the whole period of the Nabob's assignment, and the security of the Company's protection promised in the fullest manner to such persons as might become renters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To realize revenue and encourage competitive bidding, advertise lettings publicly across provinces for the full assignment period and explicitly promise Company protection to renters; public solicitation increases proposals and favorable terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retrenchment of extraordinary military charges and reorganization of forces
rubrics_metrics.description: One considerable charge upon the Nabob's country was for extraordinary sibbendies, sepoys, and horsemen, who appeared to us to be a very unnecessary incumbrance on the revenue. Your Lordship, &c., have determined to receive such of these people as will enlist into the Company's service, and discharge the rest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eliminate unnecessary standing military charges by (a) enlisting those willing into the Company's service to reduce duplicate costs and (b) discharging the remainder; this reduces burdens on revenue and helps establish effective authority for revenue collection.
